19:42 │ EN VIVO AHORA: NBA Basketball
The Minnesota Timberwolves visit the Miami Heat at Kaseya Center in Miami, Florida. Minnesota won 122-94 in Jan 2026 in their latest meeting, earning its second win in four days. The Northwest Division Timberwolves face the Southeast Division Heat.

22:05 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: NBA Basketball
The Golden State Warriors visit the Los Angeles Lakers at Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles. The Lakers won 119-103 on April 9, completing a 3-1 season-series win over the Golden State. The Pacific Division rivals meet again in the Western Conference.
